page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 server instance powered by a dedicated 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. The configuration comprises 20 physical cores and 40 virtual CPUs running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 35 MB L3 cache per socket. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AVX512_VNNI, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. System memory totals 192.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.8 GB per virtual core. The instance lacks bundled local SSD storage and integrated GPU accelerators. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Across benchmark evaluations, the server places within the middle 50 percent category for single-core and multi-core performance metrics. Single-core CPU testing yields a stress-ng score of 1438.99 and a Geekbench score of 1289.0, while multi-core testing achieves 38378.07 in stress-ng and 12045.0 in Geekbench. Uncached memory bandwidth measures 108.89 GB/sec for large block reads and 48.09 GB/sec for writes. Database operations show 14.25 thousand operations per second in PassMark and 34.78 million Redis SET operations per second. Static web serving reaches 25.35 GB/sec throughput. Large language model inference on a 7B model reaches 56.94 tokens per second for prompt processing and 12.71 tokens per second for generation. The absence of local disk storage requires reliance on external network storage for persistent data.

The high base clock speed of 3.1 GHz combined with 192 GB of memory provides compute density for tasks requiring predictable clock performance across 40 vCPUs. The hardware profile offers balanced cost efficiency for compute-centric workloads that do not require local NVMe drives or discrete GPU acceleration. The instance is suited for enterprise web serving, software compilation, database caching with Redis, data processing pipelines, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
